subject: TARGET CLAIM: frozen visual interaction coherence / input ownership
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-interaction-rd-frozen-input-coherence-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. Post-focus board recheck found concurrent visual-phase/frame-pacing, hinge-ingress edge-preservation, and semantic re-close claims; none owns user input delivery beneath Duo overlays. Scope: define and validate an exact-identity interaction gate for periods where Duo presents a frozen/occluding visual as the user's temporary source of truth. Current FoldSurface and DisplayMirrorHost overlays use FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE, and Gen3 closing uses SnapshotSurface, so visible frozen pixels and actionable native UI can diverge. Boundary: opening live blur remains pass-through; no visual-state redesign, no semantic freshness policy, no native-present truth, no presentation callback ownership, no angle/reversal redesign. Gate authority must be tied to the exact current visual/content/host/service identity and fail open on owner loss, reversal, route/privilege loss, service destroy, or terminal completion; stale callbacks may never re-block. First validation is Android-free model/adversarial tests plus source mapping. No production Git writes.
